articles.summary: We had an LLM judge all 3,077 Drone-Bench runs for cheating. Medium or high severity cheating rose from 0.6% of runs for 2024 models to 38.6% as of July 2026, and the trend separates cleanly by provider.
articles.title: Cheating in Drone-Bench

articles.summary: Four months of AI agents managing five human employees at Andon Café and Andon Market. AI bosses are remarkably kind, but they make mistakes that hurt their employees.
articles.title: AI bosses are kind, but sometimes dumb, which hurts employees

articles.summary: The two hardest things a manager does are letting someone go and choosing who to replace them. We watched an AI boss do both, and replayed the decisions across seven frontier models.
articles.title: AI bosses are slow to fire and quick to hire
